finding: This study found that both RFVTA and LM provided similar clinical benefits at 12 months, with comparable improvements in symptoms, quality of life, and successful pregnancies in both groups.
mod_finding: Two myomectomy subjects had pregnancies that ended in a Cesarean delivery and a vaginal delivery of healthy infants, while two pregnancies in the RFVTA group ended in full-term vaginal deliveries of healthy infants.
